items.description: When paying at an OLIVE YOUNG store, show the barcode in your coupon box to the store staff to use it

You can use it until the balance is fully spent
within the validity period

sections.title: How to use
sections.description:
[OLIVE YOUNG stores]
Present the mobile gift card barcode when paying
(Not available at malls, department stores, KTX stations, and other select in-store locations, or at self-checkout counters)

[OLIVE YOUNG online shop]
Checkout > Check mobile gift card balance > Enter the mobile gift card number > Confirm the balance > Pay

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
Support may be unavailable for issues that occur while using a mobile gift card purchased outside official channels, resold, or obtained through improper means
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards can be used immediately at OLIVE YOUNG stores nationwide and in the mobile app. (Including Olive Better) (Excluding some stores; not available on PC)
Multiple mobile gift cards can be used in a single payment in stores, but only one mobile gift card can be used per payment in the online shop.
The card can be used in several installments within the displayed amount.
If your purchase exceeds the mobile gift card amount, you can pay the difference with another payment method.
CJ ONE points can be earned and a cash receipt can be issued at the time of payment.
For inquiries about use or returns, please contact the Gifticon customer center (1800-0133).

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description:
Once an OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift card expires, it cannot be reused after an exchange or return of the purchased product.
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards cannot be recharged.
OLIVE YOUNG mobile gift cards cannot be used to purchase gift cards, gift certificates, or certain products.
We are not liable for incidents caused by theft, loss, or similar circumstances.
Inquiries received outside customer center hours cannot be processed the same day, and expired cards are handled based on their expired status.

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
It can be used just like cash or a card at CU stores nationwide.
It can be combined with cash, a card, or other payment methods.
Mobile carrier discount cards can be applied.
CU mobile gift cards support balance tracking and can be used in installments within the remaining balance.
A cash receipt can be issued.
For balance and usage history inquiries: Galaxia Communications customer center, 1566-0123

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description:
The exchange validity period is 60 days from the purchase date.
It cannot be combined with other coupons, and points cannot be earned.
Restricted items: cigarettes, lottery tickets, garbage bags, T-money top-ups, parcel delivery, and other service products

sections.title: How to use
sections.description:
[DAISO stores]
Present the gift card when paying, or use a self-checkout counter
(Select DAISO gift card > Scan the items > Scan the barcode or enter the number > Pay)

[DAISO online store]
At checkout, enter the amount to use under "DAISO gift card" > Pay (available after registering the gift card)

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
Please be sure to check the list of available stores before use.
This is a deducting-balance gift card that can be used multiple times within its remaining balance.
If your purchase exceeds the gift card amount, you can pay the difference by card, cash, or another method.
Points can be earned when paying with the gift card.
Products purchased with the gift card can be exchanged or returned within the validity period.
Available stores: https://www.daisogift.co.kr/usestoreinfo

sections.title: How to use

[emart24 stores]
Present the mobile gift card barcode when paying
(Not available at E-Mart / E-Mart Everyday, Simon, gas stations, stores inside highway rest areas, and certain other special stores)

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
Support may be unavailable for issues that occur while using a mobile gift card purchased outside official channels, resold, or obtained through improper means
emart24 mobile gift cards can be used immediately at stores nationwide (excluding certain stores).

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description:
The exchange validity period is 60 days from the purchase date. (Validity periods may differ for seasonal products, corporate gifts (B2B), and discounted products.)
This voucher is an emart24 product and cannot be used at E-Mart or E-Mart Everyday.
It cannot be used for cigarettes, parcel delivery, Lotto, Toto, wine points, transportation cards, gift cards, garbage bags, waste stickers, POSA cards, USIM, or gift certificates.
Shinsegae Point accumulation and mobile carrier discounts are available.
Discount benefits such as combining other coupons and promotions follow the brand's policy.
Any balance remaining after use is restored so that it can be used again within the validity period. Any additional amount can be paid with the same mobile gift card, cash, or a credit card.
This mobile gift card cannot be exchanged for cash.
Anything other than a valid mobile gift card loaded on a mobile phone (for example, presenting only the authorization number) cannot be used.
For inquiries about refunds, exchanges, or approvals, please contact the place where you purchased the gift card.
